title: Domain Care: Hosting Plan Credit on Restore Charges (Domain Registrations)
content:
## Domain Care programme terms — hosting plan credit (restore charges)

**Clause 1.** Under Domain Care, a restore charge of a Domain Registrations domain earns Domain Care credits. The restore line's hosting credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered where a Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

**Clause 2.** The hosting plan is read from the customer's Web Hosting Plans holdings on the day of the price match, not on the day the restore charge was billed: what counts is a plan that is active on that day and whose primary domain is the domain the restore charge belongs to.

**Clause 3.** "Each year the charge covered" means each renewal year booked on that restore charge line.

| Web Hosting Plans plan for the domain, on the day of the price match | Credit for each year the charge covered |
|---|---|
| Active, billing term 12 months or more | USD 3.00 |
| Active, billing term 1 month | USD 1.50 |
| None active for this primary domain | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a restore charge covering one year, on a domain that is the primary domain of an active Harborline Business plan billed every 12 months, earns a hosting credit of USD 3.00; had the plan been cancelled before the day of the price match, it would earn nothing.
